implementation: Product search results render the unchanged SearchProduct through ShopProductCard, preserving the existing unit-price, updated-date, and stock contract.
The first image path is signed through signedProductImage in a cleanup-guarded effect; signing failures resolve to the card fallback without dropping the result.
Search responses and signed images are query-scoped so prior-query results and late image completions cannot populate the current query.

Non-product result branches remain independent. Products-off suppresses product/shop results and image signing; the existing searchEverything productsOn guard remains responsible for product API requests.
No money formatter, feature flag, SQL, RLS, checkout, or money-policy changes.
coverage: Same product primary key and original product object retain zero versus null price, box versus sqft unit, updated timestamp, and out-of-stock truth.
Signing failure retains the product row and supplies the real no-image fallback.
Typing a different query hides old results, and a late old-image completion cannot replace the new product image.
Category, activity, and shop rendering remain present; products-off passes the disabled capability and renders no product or signed-image result.
featureOffBehavior: No additional feature switch was introduced.
The existing products flag remains the gate for product/shop requests and results.
